title: v4.1.4 corrected OpenClaw Gateway startup
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';function Run-OC([string[]]$OcArgs,[string]$Tag){$so=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.stdout.txt');$se=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.stderr.txt');Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList $OcArgs -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se;return $p.ExitCode};$code=Run-OC @('gateway','status','--json') 'gateway-probe-050v';if($code -ne 0){$install=Run-OC @('gateway','install') 'gateway-install-050v';if($install -ne 0){$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($null -eq $task){throw ('GATEWAY_INSTALL_FAILED code='+$install)}}};$restart=Run-OC @('gateway','restart') 'gateway-restart-050v';if($restart -ne 0){throw ('GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED code='+$restart)};$ok=$false;for($i=0;$i -lt 12;$i++){Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;$so=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050v.stdout.json';$se=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050v.stderr.txt';Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList @('gateway','status','--json') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se;if($p.ExitCode -eq 0){try{$null=Get-Content $so -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$ok=$true;break}catch{}}};if(-not $ok){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_NOT_HEALTHY_JSON'};Write-Output 'V414_050V_GATEWAY=PASS'
